metadata.boundary: Implements the RLM 0.1.3 external-context contract, persistent restricted code loop, and batched/recursive subcalls; official prompts, unrestricted upstream REPL, compaction, and upstream runtime are unavailable.
metadata.classification: This is an RLM-like persistent code loop, not external_context_json_search. Domain tools are intentionally withheld from its controller and subcalls.
metadata.security: Restricted in-process Python is a capability layer, not an OS sandbox.
